Name: How Jodi Got Her Groove Back - Romance Enabled
Author: mdurham6890
Description:
Her situation with Kent isn't ignored or hand-waved. It unfolds as a real storyline with real scenes, and the people involved are treated with care — all of them. If you're looking for something that skips the complicated parts, this probably isn't the right mod. If you want a romance that feels earned, hopefully this is.
Heart events trigger when you enter the right location during the listed time window. Most require you to have seen the previous event first, so the story unfolds in order.

[list]
[*]2 hearts — Town, 9am–7pm
[*]4 hearts — Sam's house, noon–5pm
[*]6 hearts — Sam's house, 5pm–10pm
[*]8 hearts — Sam's house, 5pm–10pm
[*]Additional events unlock naturally as the story progresses
[*]Marriage requires Year 2
[/list]Also includes evolving dialogue for the other people in Jodi's life, a marriage schedule that takes her around town throughout the week, and married dialogue covering daily life, the seasons, and what she's building next.

Downloads.Description: This fixed an oversight where romancing Jodi could not occur if a certain scene did not take place before Kent came home.

Manifest.Name: Romance Jodi
Manifest.Description: Adds a full romance and marriage arc with Jodi — seven heart events, spouse dialogue, and a spouse room. Jodi's situation with Kent is addressed honestly.
